question: What is the meaning of physical demounting with reversible mounting hardware in relation to demounting?
data_point: physical demounting with reversible mounting hardware
description: Physical demounting with reversible mounting hardware in relation to demounting refers to the ability to disassemble a product using hardware that allows for the product to be taken apart without causing damage. This hardware enables the product to be easily separated into its components and reassembled back together, promoting reusability and circularity in product design and manufacturing.
